description: isometric pixel art city for a trucking tycoon game map, on a transparent background, seen from the high angle of an isometric tycoon map: New Orleans with the Superdome, French Quarter rooftops and the Mississippi crescent, a dense cluster of downtown towers with lit windows and long warm shadows, a highway interchange with tiny semi trucks at the edge, a rail yard and a row of warehouses, highly detailed HD painterly pixel art shading with layered depth, warm late-afternoon light, saturated palette, the whole city fitting inside the frame with clear space around it, standing on flat ground that fades out to transparency at its edges with no platform, block or base edge under it, never any words, letters or labels
